title: Concept: Dart hosted dependency configured over cleartext
description: pubspec.yaml declares a hosted dependency URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The archive and its metadata cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can substitute the package.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.yaml (pub).
risk: The archive and its metadata cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can substitute the package.
